title: G-AnnStudio Plain-Export Sidecar Manifest
description: The `announcer-manifest.json` that G-AnnStudio's plain export (`export_all`, packages/ann-studio/src-tauri/src/lib.rs) writes alongside the raw WAV clips it cuts. This is an EXPORT INVENTORY, not the G-AnnStudio -> G-Maiden install contract: G-Maiden never reads this file. For the installed-pack contract (`voice-cache/packs/<id>/manifest.json`, written by `install_gmaiden_pack`/`install_library_pack` and parsed by G-Maiden's `voice_api::Manifest`), see `pack-manifest.schema.json` — that is where per-pack metadata such as `authorGid` lives.

pack_name.description: Display name of the announcer pack.

id.description: Stable unique id for the clip.

path.description: Relative path to the WAV file, next to this manifest.

event.description: Dota 2 event id this clip is triggered by (see packages/ann-studio dota-events).
